reason_zh: 三份已授权的 2026-09-06 Research Object 已转换为完整双语 Editorial Architecture 2.1 候选，具备已核验规划工件、有边界的证据声明、独立读者价值与确定性基础题图。

candidates.title: Escalation Risk Does Not Choose the Protocol
candidates.title_zh: 发现风险，不等于选对协作协议
candidates.researchQuestion: 当数字员工看起来可能失败时，受治理的运行系统在从“当前路径有风险”转向“现在按此成本使用这个协作协议”之前，必须分别知道什么？
candidates.coreProposition: Failure-risk admission, protocol-specific value, and budget admission are separate evidence decisions: detecting likely failure does not select a collaboration topology, and selecting a topology does not authorize its cost.

sections.heading: One Score Is Asked to Do Three Incompatible Jobs
sections.heading_zh: 一个分数承担了三个不相容的任务

sections.heading: Controlled Evidence Exposes the Gap Between Risk and Protocol Choice
sections.heading_zh: 受控证据暴露了风险与协议选择的落差

sections.heading: Three Evidence Receipts Make One Escalation
sections.heading_zh: 三份证据收据构成一次升级

sections.heading: One Model May Decide Jointly; The Evidence Still Has Layers
sections.heading_zh: 一个模型可以联合决策，证据仍要分层

sections.heading: From a Binary Feature to an Auditable Execution Policy
sections.heading_zh: 从二元功能切换到可审计执行政策

evidenceClaims.claim: In the controlled OmniMath setting, a post-answer baseline-failure probe reports AUROC 0.8847 and AUPRC 0.895 on 4,151 parseable examples.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 在受控数学题设定中，答后基础失败探针在 4,151 个可解析样本上报告 0.8847 的受试者工作特征曲线下面积和 0.895 的精确率—召回率曲线下面积。

evidenceClaims.claim: Protocol-specific value prediction is materially weaker, with reported AUPRC 0.1674 for PER-first value and 0.1041 for Broadcast-only value.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 特定协议价值预测明显较弱，研究报告规划—执行—复核优先价值的精确率—召回率曲线下面积为 0.1674，广播独有价值为 0.1041。

evidenceClaims.claim: Matched outcomes show quality-cost trade-offs and cases where more expensive collaboration does not dominate cheaper alternatives.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 匹配结果显示质量与成本之间存在权衡，而且更昂贵的协作并不在所有案例中优于较便宜方案。

evidenceClaims.claim: Failure risk, protocol value, and budget authority answer distinct escalation questions.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 本次分析观察到，失败风险、协议价值与预算权限回答不同的升级问题。

evidenceClaims.claim: A governed runtime should preserve separate evidence identities and a bounded fallback when protocol-value evidence is insufficient.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 本文据此解释，受治理的运行系统应保留不同证据身份，并在协议价值证据不足时使用有界回退。

projectRelevance.rationale: The argument derives from public primary research and retains value without any first-party project.

communityEdition.rationale: The complete Research Center edition already provides the transferable model and practical questions; a separate community edition would not add a sufficiently distinct angle.

candidates.title: Recovery Is a Trajectory, Not a Boolean
candidates.title_zh: 恢复是一条轨迹，不是一个布尔值
candidates.researchQuestion: 如果“网络最终恢复”可以与严重的中间扰动、累积负担或对不同阶段作用相反的协调政策同时存在，分布式智能体系统必须测量什么？
candidates.coreProposition: Resilience is a phase-indexed lifecycle rather than a terminal boolean: degradation, containment, restoration, cumulative burden, and authoritative state mutation require distinct evidence even when the final state is recovered.

sections.heading: What a Green Terminal State Deletes
sections.heading_zh: 绿色终态删除了哪段历史

sections.heading: A Simulation of More Than Five Thousand Agents Separates the Phases
sections.heading_zh: 五千多个智能体的模拟把阶段分开

sections.heading: One Incident Needs Five Evidence Families
sections.heading_zh: 一次事故需要五类证据

sections.heading: Proposal Authority and Environment-Mutation Authority Must Stay Separate
sections.heading_zh: 建议权与环境变更权必须分开

sections.heading: Simple Indicators May Remain; Phase Facts Must Not Disappear
sections.heading_zh: 简单指标可以保留，阶段事实不能消失

evidenceClaims.claim: The primary study models 5,076 autonomous supply-network agents while the simulation environment retains allocation, feasibility, and commit authority.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 主研究模拟了 5,076 个自主供应网络智能体，同时由模拟环境保留分配、可行性与提交权威。

evidenceClaims.claim: The study distinguishes degradation, containment or partial stabilization, restoration, and full recovery with cumulative burden.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 研究区分退化、遏制或部分稳定、恢复过程，以及完整恢复和累积负担。

evidenceClaims.claim: Faster partial stabilization can coexist with worse later restoration or cumulative disruption, and higher trust is not uniformly beneficial in the studied conditions.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 在研究条件中，更快的部分稳定可以与更差的后期恢复或累计扰动并存，更高信任也不是始终有益。

evidenceClaims.claim: Terminal recovery cannot identify the trajectory or accumulated harm that produced the terminal state.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 本次分析观察到，终态恢复无法识别通向该状态的轨迹或累计伤害。

evidenceClaims.claim: Distributed-agent resilience should preserve phase-indexed evidence and keep proposals distinct from authoritative environment mutation.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 本文据此解释，分布式智能体韧性应保留按阶段索引的证据，并把建议与权威环境变更分开。

projectRelevance.rationale: The argument is based on independent primary research and does not require any first-party project.

communityEdition.rationale: The complete Research Center edition already provides the transferable model and practical questions; a separate community edition would not add a sufficiently distinct angle.

candidates.title: Stable Identity Does Not Authorize a Destination
candidates.title_zh: 稳定身份，不授权新的目的地
candidates.researchQuestion: 当持久智能体状态被恢复到重建或不同的目的地时，即使逻辑智能体或工作流身份保持稳定，系统仍必须重新验证什么？
candidates.coreProposition: Stable principal identity enables trustworthy state attribution but does not grant destination or execution authority; safe resume separately proves identity, continuity, current destination compatibility, and current permission.

sections.heading: Stable Identity Solves Attribution, Not Permission
sections.heading_zh: 稳定身份解决归属，不解决许可

sections.heading: Two Implementations Expose Complementary Boundaries
sections.heading_zh: 两个实现展示了互补边界

sections.heading: Four Gates Decide Whether Resume Is Admitted
sections.heading_zh: 四道门共同决定能否恢复

sections.heading: Workspaces, Sessions, and Forks Are Re-admission Boundaries
sections.heading_zh: 工作空间、会话与派生都是重新准入点

sections.heading: One Function May Perform the Checks; Evidence Cannot Collapse
sections.heading_zh: 一个函数可以做完，证据不能混成一个字段

sections.heading: External Effects Need Their Own Caution
sections.heading_zh: 对外部副作用保持单独谨慎

evidenceClaims.claim: The examined OpenAI Agents SDK commit derives stable graph identity, disambiguates duplicate names, excludes transient bound-session objects, and fails closed on unresolved identity-aware targets in covered paths.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 所检查的 OpenAI 智能体软件开发工具包提交在覆盖路径中派生稳定图身份、消歧同名目标、排除短暂绑定会话对象，并对无法解析的身份感知目标失败关闭。

evidenceClaims.claim: The examined OpenAI Codex commit re-evaluates destination trust, configuration, state, queued or active disqualifiers, projected instructions, permission profile, and session facts before managed-worktree ownership.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 所检查的 OpenAI Codex 提交在托管工作树获得所有权前，重新检查目的地信任、配置、状态、排队或活动排除条件、投射指令、权限配置与会话事实。

evidenceClaims.claim: The two implementations show that identifying a durable principal does not establish that a destination may host or execute it now.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 本次比较观察到，识别持久主体并不能证明某个目的地现在可以承载或执行它。

evidenceClaims.claim: Governed recovery should expose principal identity, state continuity, destination compatibility, and execution authority as separate gates.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 本文据此解释，受治理的恢复应把主体身份、状态连续性、目的地兼容性与执行权限作为不同门禁。

projectRelevance.rationale: The argument compares public external implementations and remains useful without any first-party project.

communityEdition.rationale: The complete Research Center edition already provides the transferable model and practical questions; a separate community edition would not add a sufficiently distinct angle.
